newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Key facts about S-300 missile system.
newsitem.headline: Key facts about S-300 missile system.

text.p: Following are the basic specifications of the S-300 surface-to-air missile system that Cyprus plans to buy from Russia, as reported by Jane's Land-Based Air Defence.
Visiting Athens, Cypriot President Glafcos Clerides said on Thursday his country was determined to deploy the missiles, which have sent tensions soaring in the eastern Mediterranean.
- Maximum effective interception range of aircraft-type targets at 150 km (90 miles). Minimum effective interception altitude 10 metres (yards).
- Engagement of ballistic-type targets successfully at ranges up to 40 km (25 miles).
- Maximum target velocity capability of 2,788 metres (yards) per second (10,000 km/h).
- Battery deployment time five minutes. One missile can be fired every three seconds.
- Maximum total of missiles available in the battery is 32 rounds.
